title: Bhagiratha strives to bring Ganga to earth
introduction: Bhageeratha's effort for bringing Ganga to earth is fulfilled. Amshuman and his son Dileepa could not make any effort to bring the divine river to earth. But Bhageeratha, the son of Dileepa, staunch at heart tries earnestly to get her onto earth. Brahma agreeing for this descent of Ganga designates lord Shiva to bear the burden of the onrush of Ganga, because the earth cannot sustain it.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे द्विचत्वारिंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 42nd chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
कालधर्मं गते राम सगरे प्रकृतीजनाः |
राजानं रोचयामासुरंशुमन्तं सुधार्मिकम्
verses.iast:
kāladharmam gate rāma sagare prakṛtī janāḥ |
rājānam rocayāmāsur aṃśumantam sudhārmikam
verses.translation: "When King Sagara passed away owing to the irrefutable virtue of Time, the ministers and subjects of that kingdom are predisposed towards the highly honourable Amshuman to become their king and they enthroned him accordingly." Thus Vishvamitra continued narration about the predecessors of Rama.

glosses.meaning: Sagara, by Time's, virtue, gone - on passing away
as king, predisposed to - and enthroned.

verses.devanagari:
स राजा सुमहानासीदंशुमान् रघुनंदन |
तस्य पुत्रो महानासीद्दिलीप इति विश्रुतः
verses.iast:
sa rājā sumahān āsīt aṃśumān raghunandana |
tasya putro mahān āsīt dilīpa iti viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: "He that Amshuman turned out to be a very great king, and oh, Rama of Raghu's dynasty, he begot a marvellous son who is renowned as Dileepa.

glosses.meaning: as very, exceptional, king, he was there
marvellous, son, has become - took birth.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मै राज्यं समादिश्य दिलीपे रघुनंदन |
हिमवच्छिखरे रम्ये तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम्
verses.iast:
tasmai rājyam samādiśya dilīpe raghunandana |
himavat śikhare raṃye tapaḥ tepe sudāruṇam
verses.translation: "Assigning the kingdom to Dileepa, oh, Rama of Raghu's dynasty, Amshuman undertook very stern ascesis on a pleasant peak of Himalayas desiring the descent of River Ganga to earth.

verses.devanagari:
द्वात्रिंशच्च सहस्राणि वर्षाणि सुमहायशाः |
तपोवनगतो राजा स्वर्गं लेभे तपोधनः
verses.iast:
dvā triṃśat sahasrām varṣāṇi sumahā yaśāḥ |
tapovana gato rājā svargam lebhe tapodhanaḥ
verses.translation: "On practising ascesis in ascetic-woods for thirty-two thousand years that highly renowned king Amshuman achieved heaven as he acquired only the wealth of practising the ascesis.
notes: Instead of achieving reward of ascesis in the form of descent of River Ganga, he could achieve only his personal merit of his penance, namely an abode in heaven.

glosses.meaning: two, three, hundred, thousands, years- thirty-two thousand years
to ascetic, woods, on going - practising ascesis
ascesis, asset - one whose wealth is practising ascesis, but not its reward

verses.devanagari:
दिलीपस्तु महातेजाः श्रुत्वा पैतामहं वधम् |
दुःखोपहतया बुद्ध्या निश्चयं नाध्यगच्छत
verses.iast:
dilīpaḥ tu mahātejāḥ śrutvā paitāmaham vadham |
duḥkha upahatayā buddhyā niścayam na adhyagacchata
verses.translation: "The great resplendent Dileepa on hearing the elimination of his grandfathers, the sixty thousand sons of Sagara at the hand of sage Kapila, and with a mind that is marred by the plight of his father Amshuman in absolving the souls of Sagara's sons, he that Dileepa could not arrive at any decision concerning the descent of Ganga.

glosses.meaning: great, resplendent, Dileepa, on his part
of grandfather's [sixty thousand sons of Sagara,] elimination, on hearing
by agony, marred, with a mind - at the plight of his father Amshuman

verses.devanagari:
कथं गंगावतरणं कथं तेषां जलक्रिया |
तारयेयं कथं चैतानिति चिंतापरोऽभवत्
verses.iast:
katham gaṅgā avataraṇam katham teṣāṃ jalakriyā |
tārayeyam katham ca etān iti cintāparo abhavat
verses.translation: "Dileepa became worried as to how River Ganga is to be alighted onto earth from heaven, how water-oblations are to be offered for the souls of Sagara's sons, and how to cross them, the souls, over this mortal world.

glosses.meaning: Ganga, alighting, how - to make it possible
them, how to, cross over [them from this mortal bindings of heaps of ashes,] also

verses.devanagari:
तस्य चिंतयतो नित्यं धर्मेण विदितात्मनः |
पुत्रो भगीरथो नाम जज्ञे परमधार्मिकः
verses.iast:
tasya cintayato nityam dharmeṇa vidita ātmanaḥ |
putro bhagīratho nāma jaGYe parama dhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: "To him who is self-mortified and who is always thinking righteously about the alight of Ganga onto earth, to such a Dileepa a most-virtuous son is born who is renowned by his name Bhageeratha.

glosses.meaning: knower, of soul [self-mortified one, or, unclear at mind]
always, who is thinking [about alighting of Ganga to earth]

verses.devanagari:
दिलीपस्तु महातेजा यज्ञैर्बहुभिरिष्टवान् |
त्रिंशद्वर्षसहस्राणि राजा राज्यमकारयत्
verses.iast:
dilīpaḥ tu mahātejā yaGYaiḥ bahubhiḥ iṣṭavān |
triṃśat varṣa sahasrāṇi rājā rājyam akārayat
verses.translation: "That great-resplendent king Dileepa on his part performed numerous Vedic-rituals, and he ruled the kingdom for thirty thousand years - to the delight of each of his subjects, but could not find a way to fetch Ganga.

verses.devanagari:
अगत्वा निश्चयं राजा तेषामुद्धरणं प्रति |
व्याधिना नरशार्दूल कालधर्ममुपेयिवान्
verses.iast:
agatvā niścayam rājā teṣām uddharaṇam prati |
vyādhinā nara śārdūla kāla dharmam upeyivān
verses.translation: "Oh, tigerly-man Rama, that king Dileepa by not attaining any choice towards the uplifting the souls of his grandparents to heaven by bringing Ganga to earth, he took to illness, and he attained the ultimate virtue of Time, namely the demise.

glosses.meaning: of their, up, lifting [to heaven,] towards - regarding

verses.devanagari:
इन्द्रलोकं गतो राजा स्वार्जितेनैव कर्मणा |
राज्ये भगीरथं पुत्रमभिषिच्य नरर्षभः
verses.iast:
indralokam gato rājā sva ar.hjitena eva karmaṇā |
rajye bhagīratham putram abhiṣicya nararṣabhaḥ
verses.translation: "That best one among men, namely king Dileepa, on anointing his son Bhageeratha in the kingdom went to the abode of Indra, namely the heaven, only by his self-acquired merits of deeds.

glosses.meaning: best one among men, that king - Dileepa
son, Bhageeratha, in kingdom, on anointing sva aarjitena karmaNaa eva = self, acquired, by merits of deeds, only

verses.devanagari:
भगीरथस्तु राजर्षिर्धार्मिको रघुनंदन |
अनपत्यो महाराजः प्रजाकामः स च प्रजाः
verses.iast:
bhagīrathaḥ tu rājarṣiḥ dhārmiko raghunandana |
anapatyo mahārajāḥ prajā kāmaḥ sa ca prajāḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, the legatee of Raghu, but on his part that self-righteous and kingly-sage Bhageeratha is childless, and that great king longed-for offspring.

glosses.meaning: subjects, and, - kingdom: he placed in the hands of ministers - these two words are to go into the meaning of next verse.

verses.devanagari:
मंत्रिष्वाधाय तद्राज्यं गङ्गावतरणे रतः|
तपो दीर्घं समातिष्ठद्गोकर्णे रघुनंदन
ऊर्ध्वबाहुः पंचतपा मासाहारो जितेन्द्रियः |
verses.iast:
mantriṣu ādhāya tat rajyam gañga avataraṇe rataḥ |
tapo dīrgham samātiṣṭhat gokarṇe raghunandana
ūrdhva bāhuḥ pañca tapā māsa āhāro jiteindriyaḥ |
verses.translation: "Interested in the alighting of River Ganga on earth, oh, Rama, the descendent of Raghu, king Bhageeratha delegated his kingdom to the custody of his ministers and people and firmed up himself in sustained asceticism on Mt. Gokarna in Himalayas, and he practise ascesis standing amid five-fires, upraising his hands, with a monthly sustenance and with his sense conquered.
notes: The five-fires are panca agni-s the four earthly fires in four corners of directions and the sun's fire overhead.

glosses.meaning: verily, came, sat tight, - firmed up in.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य वर्षसहस्राणि घोरे तपसि तिष्ठतः
अतीतानि महाबहो तस्य राज्ञो महात्मनः |
सुप्रीतो भगवान्ब्रह्मा प्रजानां पतिरीश्वरः
verses.iast:
tasya varṣa sahasrāṇi ghore tapasi tiṣṭhataḥ
atītāni mahabaho tasya rāGYo mahātmanaḥ |
suprīto bhagavān brahmā prajānām patiḥ īśvaraḥ
verses.translation: "Thousands of years have rolled by while Bhageeratha stood practising his severe ascesis, oh, dextrous Rama, and then the lord and master of all beings, namely god Brahma, is well pleased with that great-souled king's ascesis.

glosses.meaning: his, in severe, ascesis, while sat tight - firmly practising
of his, great-souled one, of king - in his respect

verses.devanagari:
ततः सुरगणैः सार्धमुपागम्य पितामहः |
भगीरथं महात्मानं तप्यमानमथाब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tataḥ sura gaṇaiḥ sārdham upāgaṃya pitāmahaḥ |
bhagīratham mahātmānam tapyamānam atha abravīt
verses.translation: "Forefather Brahma then arrived along with assemblages of gods, and spoke this way to the great-souled Bhageeratha who is deep in the practise of ascesis.

glosses.meaning: who is in ascesis - deep in the practise of ascesis

verses.devanagari:
भगीरथ महाराग प्रीतस्तेऽहं जनाधिप |
तपसा च सुतप्तेन वरं वरय सुव्रत
verses.iast:
bhagīratha mahārāja prītaḥ te aham janādhipa |
tapasā ca sutaptena varam varaya suvrata
verses.translation: " 'Oh, great king Bhageeratha, oh, lord of the people, I am delighted with the perfectly conducted ascesis of yours, hence oh, truly committed one, you may beseech for a boon.

verses.devanagari:
तमुवाच महातेजाः सर्वलोकपितामहम् |
भगीरथो महाबाहुः कृतांजलिपुटः स्थितः
verses.iast:
tam uvāca mahātejāḥ sarvaloka pitāmaham |
bhagīratho mahābāhuḥ kṛta añjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ
verses.translation: "That great resplendent and highly fortunate king Bhageeratha then remaining with suppliantly adjoined palm fold spoke to him who is the Forefather of all worlds, namely Brahma.

verses.devanagari:
यदि मे भगवान्प्रीतो यद्यस्ति तपसः फलम् |
सगरस्यात्मजाः सर्वे मत्तः सलिलस्याप्नुयुः
verses.iast:
yadi me bhagavān prīto yadi asti tapasaḥ phalam |
sagarasya ātmajāḥ sarve mattaḥ salilam āpnuyuḥ
verses.translation: " 'Oh, god, if you are satisfied with my ascesis, and if there is any fruition to the ascesis of mine, let all the sons of Sagara get water oblations through me.

glosses.meaning: for ascesis, fruit, is there, if

verses.devanagari:
गङ्गायाः सलिलक्लिन्ने भस्मन्येषां महात्मनाम् |
स्वर्गं गच्छेयुरत्यन्तं सर्वे मे प्रपितामहाः
verses.iast:
gangāyāḥ salila klinne bhasmani eṣām mahātmanām |
svargam gaccheyur atyantam sarve me prapitāmahāḥ
verses.translation: " 'While the ashes of these great souls are drenched with the waters of Ganga, let all of those great-grandfathers of mine depart to heaven, eternally.

glosses.meaning: of Ganga's, by water, while being drenched

verses.devanagari:
देव याचे ह संतत्यै नावसीदेत्कुलं च नः |
इक्ष्वाकूणां कुले देव एष मेऽस्तु वरः परः
verses.iast:
deva yāce ha santatyai na avasīdet kulam ca naḥ |
ikṣvākūṇām kule deva eṣa me astu varaḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: " 'Oh, god, I indeed pray for offspring in our Ikshvaku dynasty, let not our dynasty dwindle as I am issueless, and oh, god, let this be the other boon to me.

glosses.meaning: our, dynasty, not, to dwindle, also
this, mine, other, boon, let it be.

verses.devanagari:
उक्तवाक्यं तु राजानं सर्वलोकपितामहः |
प्रत्युवाच शुभां वाणीं मधुरं मधुराक्षराम्
verses.iast:
ukta vākyam tu rājānam sarvaloka pitāmahaḥ |
pratyuvāca śubhām vāṇīm madhuram madhura akṣarām
verses.translation: "The Forefather of all the worlds, Brahma, then replied the king who has spoken in that way, in an auspicious tongue that is sweet-sounding and sweetly worded, as well.

glosses.meaning: one who has said such sentence - requested such boon - Bhageeratha

verses.devanagari:
मनोरथो महानेष भगीरथ महारथ |
एवं भवतु भद्रं ते इक्ष्वाकुकुलवर्धन
verses.iast:
manoratho mahān eṣa bhagīratha mahāratha |
evam bhavatu bhadram te ikṣvāku kula vardhana
verses.translation: " 'Oh, top-speeded chariot-rider Bhageeratha, this aspiration of yours is sublime, and oh, the furtherer of Ikshvaku dynasty, so be it, let safeness betide you.

verses.devanagari:
इयं हैमवती ज्येष्ठा गंगा हिमवतः सुता |
तां वै धारयितुं राजन् हरस्तत्र नियुज्यताम्
verses.iast:
iyam haimavatī jyeṣṭhā gaṅgā himavataḥ sutā |
tām vai dhārayitum rājan haraḥ tatra niyujyatām
verses.translation: " 'This Ganga is the one with snow-broth, the elder daughter of Himavanta, and oh, king Bhageeratha, god Shiva alone is capable to sustain her force in the course of her alighting onto earth, and in fact, he is to be commissioned for that purpose.

glosses.meaning: from Himavanta born, or one having snow-broth
there, therefor - in that matter of sustaining Ganga
is to be designated - commissioned, in fact.

verses.devanagari:
गंगायाः पतनं राजन् पृथिवी न सहिष्यते |
तां वै धारयितुं राजन् नान्यं पश्यामि शूलिनः
verses.iast:
gaṅgāyāḥ patanam rājan pṛthivī na sahiṣyate |
tām vai dhārayitum rājan na anyam paśyāmi śūlinaḥ
verses.translation: " 'Oh, king Bhageeratha, the earth cannot endure the downfall of Ganga and to sustain Ganga, oh, king, indeed I do not behold none other than the Trident-wielder, god Shiva.' Thus Brahma spoke to Bhageeratha.

verses.devanagari:
तमेवमुक्त्वा राजानं गङ्गां चाभाष्य लोककृत् |
जगाम त्रिदिवं देवैः सह सर्वैर्मरुद्गणैः
verses.iast:
tam evam uktvā rājānam gaṅgām ca ābhāṣya lokakṛt |
jagāma tridivam devaiḥ sarvaiḥ saha marut gaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Speaking this way to the king Bhageeratha and informally greeting Ganga also, that Creator of Worlds, Brahma, left for heaven along with all the groups of gods and Wind-gods." Thus Vishvamitra continued narration about the arrival of River Ganga to earth.

glosses.meaning: to Ganga, also, on speaking - having a little talk, saying hello
with, all, gods, Wind-gods, with groups of
